verdict.rationale: Jeeves says it offers 'smart invoice scanning technology' that can fill in recipient details instead of entering them by hand. It also offers invoice payment approval flows and MCP tools for agents to review bill pay invoices and manage vendor payment details. Together these cover scanning bills, pre-populating payees and reviewing before paying, but the scanning claim is a single thin marketing line. Missing for 10: detailed docs on what fields the invoice scanning extracts and how accurately, explicit AI/OCR reading of incoming bills (e.g., email ingestion), a documented review-before-pay workflow for scanned bills, independent or hands-on corroboration.
